name: Hyrule Castle Barrier
description: A blue electric field that blocks passage until deactivated.

fields.name: Deactivation Effect
fields.description: Determines the effect played when the barrier is deactivated.

0.name: Normal
0.description: Plays the secret sound when deactivated.

1.name: Silent
1.description: Deactivates without playing the secret sound.

2.name: Orange Explosion
2.description: Turns orange and explodes without playing a sound.

fields.name: Deactivation Variable
fields.description: The room-local variable that deactivates the barrier when set to true.

fields.name: Output Variable
fields.description: The room-local variable set to true when the barrier is deactivated.
